response.original_title: Napoli al tempo degli Angioini, Donnareggina Vecchia
response.overview: A journey into medieval Naples to discover Donnaregina Vecchia, one of the city’s hidden treasures. Through the frescoes of Pietro Cavallini, the figure of Mary of Hungary, and the lives of the Franciscan nuns, this documentary explores the artistic and spiritual splendor of the Angevin era.
